Definition: Generic future platform contract with fields profileId, engineName, optional engineVersion, protectedPaths, proposalPaths, artifactTypes, operations, manifestRules, and boundaryNotice.
Concept covering proposal identity, profile identity, operation name, inputs, intended changes, deterministic checks, expected outputs, risks, required human gate, and status.
Potential first domain profile fixture, represented as fixture data only and not Chirality core runtime behavior.
Profile field/text stating Chirality does not provide professional approval, code compliance, external validation, or Chirality-owned solver truth.
Domain-engine paths that are not directly agent-writable and must stay separated from proposalPaths.
Agent-writable proposal paths that must remain separate from protectedPaths.
Deterministic adapter manifest rules validated as a required profile aspect.
Validation that fails invalid or incomplete profiles before runtime exposure (FR-109).
Explicit human acceptance required before applying domain operations (K-DOMAIN-3/FR-113).
PKG-10 posture placing domain profiles, operations, and endpoints in future amendment scope, not current release.
Expected vs observed PRD SHA256 mismatch treated as a source warning only per assignment override.
Note separating profile-level, adapter-level, operation-proposal-level assumptions from explicit core-runtime non-assumptions.
